theme_strategy.rationale: Storage management and infrastructure tools benefit from a high-contrast, technical dark theme to reduce eye strain during extended use and evoke a 'command center' feel.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Capitalize overlines with wide tracking. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable humanist sans for UI labels, paragraphs, and general content.

monospace_and_data.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all file names, file sizes, connection strings, IPs, ports, S3 buckets, and data tables. It emphasizes the technical nature of the app.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Keep the background purely solid #0A0A0A.
Use Electric Cyan (#00E5FF) strictly for primary actions, active connection states, and progress bars.
Hover states must be explicitly defined (e.g., hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] hover:text-white).
Tint neutrals with a hint of blue so they don't look muddy.
Use sharp edges. Override shadcn border radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 2px or 4px).
No glassmorphism. Flat solid surfaces only to prevent visual refraction of dense data.
Replace soft drop-shadows with 1px solid strokes (border-border).
Add a subtle inner glow (box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05)) to elevated cards.
Use 'Tracing Beam' or glowing borders exclusively for 'Active/Connected' storage nodes.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_stats: MODE B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.file_manager: Use a robust table/list pattern. The sidebar (Storage Switcher) should be fixed on the left (w-64), with the main file browser filling the remaining space (flex-1).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. File tables should have dense padding (py-2 px-4) to maximize visible files.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized to match the tactical theme.

specifics.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary buttons use bg-[#00E5FF] text-black.
specifics.inputs: Flat, 1px border, bg-[#121212], focus:border-[#00E5FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E5FF].
specifics.tables: Dense. border-b border-[#2A2A2A] on rows. Hover effect on rows: hover:bg-[#1A1A1A].
specifics.modals: Solid bg-[#121212], strict 1px border. Backdrop must be bg-black/80 (high opacity).
specifics.tabs: Underline style preferred over pills. border-b-2 border-transparent data-[state=active]:border-[#00E5FF].

rules: No long bouncy animations. State changes should be crisp (150ms).
Use hover transitions on table rows and file items.
Use progress indicators (Progress component) for file uploads, simulating real-time chunking.
Do NOT use transition-all. Be specific (transition-colors, transition-opacity).
Text contrast must meet APCA standards. Dark grey text on dark backgrounds is forbidden.
Focus states must be explicitly visible with ring-2.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-file-button').
Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like delete or download).

icons.rationale: Phosphor provides the crisp, technical look needed for infrastructure and file management.

login_background.description: Abstract data nodes/neural networks. Use as a subtle, low-opacity background for the login screen.

admin_hero.description: Rack of servers. Use in the Admin settings/connections banner if applicable.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not use HTML-based components for dropdowns, modals, or toasts. Use Shadcn components (DropdownMenu, Dialog).
CRITICAL: Use Sonner for toast notifications (success/error for uploads, connection tests).
CRITICAL: Ensure the UI does NOT look like a generic SaaS template. Enforce the dark, stark, technical aesthetic with JetBrains Mono for data.
CRITICAL: No transparent backgrounds under text. Always use a solid background for dropdowns and sticky headers.
CRITICAL: Ensure proper z-index layering for modals over the file browser.
CRITICAL: All buttons, forms, and key elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Implement a robust Storage Switcher in the sidebar. Active storage should have a cyan highlight.
File Browser must include Breadcrumbs for navigation.
Use a role-based layout: Admin sees dashboard stats & connection management; Regular users see only assigned storages and the file browser.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic 'AI slop' design. Do not center-align the app container.
Never use generic AI emojis. Use Phosphor icons.
Ensure crisp edges via semi-transparent borders + solid surfaces.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Do not use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image_urls.
